name: LavaCrust
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.503

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: built here (no CC0 lava scan is usable): plates of varied size from three overlaid crack fields, each plate at its own level and tilt, ropy pahoehoe folds with a glassy skin on some plates and rough aa clinker on the others, oxidised rims, Poly Haven rock_face_04 for surface grain. The E mask is the floor of the main cracks only, in the hot 40 percent of the field, with a faint halo up the crack walls
known_weaknesses: third pass: the glow is now broken into lengths in the deep cracks, but plate outlines are still smooth-noise contours (rounded, loop-shaped) rather than fracture; still fails as photoreal lava crust
emissive: E mask 0..1; suggested colour ramp (1.0,0.12,0.0) to (1.0,0.75,0.25), strength 20-60 nits scaled by E
